subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

(1) 4 - 125

(2) 3 - 64

(3) 2 - 8

(4) 6 - 343
solution:
Logic : Cube of (1st number +1) = 2nd number

​​So,​

__
 
• (1) : 4 - 125

​(4 + 1)³ = 125

(5)³ = 125

125 = 125 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (2) : 3 - 64

​(3 + 1)³ = 64

(4)³ = 64

64 = 64 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (3) : 2 - 8

​(2 + 1)³ = 8

(3)³ = 8

**27 ≠ 8 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

 
• (4) : 6 - 343

​(6 + 1)³ = 343

(7)³ = 343

343 = 343 (LHS = RHS)

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
